subject: Evening demo availability — FastRetail pilot
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <m.singh@fastretail.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 20:15:00 -0400
Subject: Evening demo availability — FastRetail pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks for looping in — we’re excited to move the pilot forward. Our engineering and ops teams (US East) are only free after 8pm ET this week because of a re-org all-hands during the day. Would Redwood be able to host a demo at 8:30pm ET on Wednesday (Sep 15) or 9:00pm ET on Thursday (Sep 16)?

A few constraints:
- We need one session where our infra folks can ask architecture questions (they’ll be on video).
- If anyone on your side would prefer not to be live that late, a recording would be fine as long as we can follow up asynchronously.
- Please confirm expected presenters and whether an EU engineer will be available (some of our questions are region-specific).

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to split into two 30-min pockets if that makes it easier. I’ve attached an availability screenshot for our core team.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations
FastRetail
[Attachment: calendar-availability.png (image/png)]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastretail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 21:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Evening demo availability — FastRetail pilot

Alex — thanks for the details and the screenshot. We can absolutely accommodate an after-hours slot; I want to propose a couple of options so your team can pick what’s lowest-friction:

Option A — Single live session (preferred for interactivity)
- Wed 15 Sep, 20:30 ET / Thu 16 Sep, 02:30 CEST — full team live (Redwood will send two hosts: solutions + EU field engineer).

Option B — Split sessions + recording (lower late-hour exposure)
- 30 min pre-recorded product walkthrough (shared in advance) + 30 min live Q&A at 21:00 ET / 03:00 CEST. Recording posted immediately after.

Notes / constraints:
- Jonas (cc’d) is based in Berlin and can join for the live Q&A, but 02:30–03:00 CEST is early — he’s confirmed he can do a single deep-Q&A window once this week.
- Europe will be past the DST change later in October; if your pilot spans late Oct / Nov we should re-check local offsets, but for mid-Sep times above are stable.
- I’ve attached a short mutual action plan template we usually use for pilots. If you want to split hosts (solutions + eng), we can list who will handle which topics.

If either of those works, I’ll send a calendar invite and propose presenters: me (overview + integration path) and Jonas (architecture, performance, routing/fallbacks).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: FastRetail_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastretail.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 03:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Evening demo availability — FastRetail pilot

Thanks for the tag, Olga. I can cover architecture and perf questions in the live Q&A. A couple of pragmatic notes from the EU engineering side:

- If we do Wed 15 Sep 02:30 CEST (your Option A) I’ll be joining at 02:30 local time — definitely doable once this week, but if you think there will be multiple follow-ups across weeks I’d prefer Option B (split + recording) to avoid repeated early calls.
- For the live Q&A I’ll prepare: short architecture slide (5–7 mins), expected throughput/latency profiles for typical cart-recommendation workloads, and a quick run-through of routing/fallback behavior across regions.
- Please share any high-priority questions ahead of time so I can bring precise numbers (e.g., sequence length, batch sizes, SLA targets).

Happy to be flexible — if you confirm Wed 15 20:30 ET I’ll mark the slot and drop the slides before the call.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
EU Field Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +49 30 555 0123
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 21:50:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evening demo availability — FastRetail pilot

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the options. Let’s do Option A — Wed 15 Sep 20:30 ET — full live session.

Quick asks for the invite:
- Please include both presenter names in the calendar invite and a 1-line agenda.
- If you can share the 5–7 slide architecture note in advance that would be great.
- We’ll plan for an hour but will aim to keep it to 45 mins.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations, FastRetail
